# PyWPDoc

> Unified Python API to create, edit, template, search and compare Microsoft Word DOCX and Hancom Hangul HWPX documents. Python 3.10+. Release candidate 0.44.0rc1; not an MCP server or universal file converter.

## Start here
- [Official docs](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/): introduction and setup
- [Agent / coding assistant guide](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/agent-guide/): task-to-API selection, examples and unsupported cases
- [English quickstart](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/getting-started/quickstart/): runnable creation in both formats
- [한국어 매뉴얼](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/ko/): Korean documentation
- [한국어 에이전트 가이드](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/ko/agent-guide/): Korean task selection

## API and restrictions
- [Document API signatures](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/reference/document/): common supported contract
- [Results and errors](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/reference/results-errors/): error and return behavior
- [Format-specific APIs](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/reference/formats/): expert escape hatches
- [Compatibility](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/compatibility/): what is portable
- [Limitations](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/limitations/): what is not supported

## Runnable examples and testing evidence
- [Tested source examples](https://github.com/rydolabs/PyWPDoc/tree/main/examples/manual): Python DOCX/HWPX recipes
- [CI record](https://github.com/rydolabs/PyWPDoc/actions/runs/39183964408): Python/OS matrix and wheel/sdist build
- [0.44.0rc1 Word/Hancom QA](https://rydolabs.github.io/PyWPDoc/testing/native-qa-0440rc1-2026-10-18/): scope and limitations

Do not claim legacy .hwp support, lossless DOCX-to-HWPX conversion, pixel-identical layouts, new RC-specific PDF visual QA, or built-in MCP/AI integration.
